does_not_apply_to.reason: generic pool contains rectangular pallets where a 90 deg yaw is NOT the same physical target; applying C4 there would teach a false equivalence

allowed_targets: G = {identity, yaw+90, yaw+180, yaw+270} applied as whole-cuboid index permutations
loss: Lsym = min over g in G of L(pred, GT o perm_g)
selection_unit: one GT object; all positive anchors assigned to that object share the same branch
coordinate_and_visibility: the same permutation is applied to the full [x,y,v] triplet; they cannot diverge by construction (a single gather over the keypoint axis)
derivation: 3D vertex coordinates rotated by Ry(deg), matched back to original indices by exact coordinate distance (<1e-9)

downstream_risk.consequence_if_phase_flips: tvec jumps to the adjacent face centre (0.55*sqrt(2) = 0.778 m for a 1.10 m square) and yaw jumps by 90 deg
downstream_risk.gate: C4 metric improvement alone does not justify deployment
